name: NavMenu
description: A nested navigation menu. Branches expand in place, the path to the active item is opened for it, and a collapsed branch stays in the markup so a page without JavaScript still shows the whole tree.

value.description: The active item, marked with aria-current=page.

expandedValues.description: Open branches. Null lets the menu open the path to the active item itself.

item{UpperCamelValue}.description: Trusted content replacing one item's label, which is where a leading icon goes.
